notes.title: We are there!
notes.content:
Hey dear farming friends!

We've been working on RanchLife for about 6 months.
It's particularly important to us that you become a part of our game.
We also want to dedicate our time to our community. We will therefore bring many events into the game as well as a lot of content that is requested by the community. Therefore we would be happy if you want to become a part of us. It would be a huge support if y'all put RanchLife on your Steam wish list.
We will regularly expand the shop page and keep you up to date on our social media channels.

Best wishes
Your Dreamstudios-team
